articles.body:
Testing is crucial for maintaining code quality. This article covers unit testing, integration testing, and end-to-end testing in Spring Boot applications.

## Testing Layers
1. Unit Tests with JUnit and Mockito
2. Integration Tests with @SpringBootTest
3. API Tests with MockMvc
4. Database Tests with @DataJpaTest

Let's explore each testing strategy...
